info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Consumer Advisory Services API
info.description: The Consumer Advisory Services API provides insights and recommendations to consumers regarding financial products and services. This endpoint enables users to access a range of advisory materials, tailored guidance, and expert insights that help them make informed decisions. It is particularly useful for financial institutions, advisors, and consumer service platforms looking to enhance their offerings and improve client engagement. By leveraging this API, users can effectively support their customers in navigating complex financial landscapes.

get.description: This endpoint allows consumers to retrieve information about available advisory services that assist them in making informed decisions about products and services.

requestBody.description: This request body allows the client to specify parameters required for the retrieval of consumer advisory services. Ensure that the request contains all necessary details to process the advisory request effectively.
